customer_question: Can we filter which event types an endpoint receives?
expert_resolution: Yes. Each endpoint subscribes to a list of event types, or * for all. Edit the endpoint in Dashboard > Webhooks and select only the types you need, or update it with POST /v2/endpoints/{id}.

customer_question: Our endpoint uses a self-signed certificate on staging. Deliveries fail.
expert_resolution: Relay only accepts certificates from public certificate authorities, so self-signed certificates fail with tls_error. Use a free certificate from a public CA such as Let's Encrypt on staging.

customer_question: Where can I download past invoices?
expert_resolution: All invoices are under Dashboard > Settings > Billing > Invoices. They are issued on the first day of each billing period.

customer_question: Does the Python SDK retry 429 responses automatically?
expert_resolution: Yes. relay-python retries network errors, 429 and 5xx responses up to max_retries times (default 3) with backoff, and honors Retry-After.

customer_question: Is payload data encrypted at rest?
expert_resolution: Yes. Event payloads are encrypted at rest with AES-256, and Relay is SOC 2 Type II certified. Your account manager can share the report.
